title: Pence accuses China of 'malign' campaign to undermine Trump
text: Pence accuses China of 'malign' campaign to undermine Trump Friday, 5 October 2018 ( ▶ Pence Casts China as Republican Campaign Foe in Speech 04:35 Oct.04 -- Vice President Mike Pence laid out allegations of Chinese election interference in a harshly worded speech Thursday, signaling a firmer U.S. pushback against Beijing as trade anxiety weighs on the looming midterm congressional elections. Jodi Schneider report on "Bloomberg Daybreak: Asia."
